x: Percy Porter, in the Hammer, has not reached his best but it is good to see Jock Whyte improving, winning the Middlesex only to have a bad day in the Scottish Championships.
In the hammer Percy Porter and Jock Whyte gained 3rd place and John Ware, with the ever-versatile Jim McGrath,picked up 6th place in the Javelin.
Bill Couzens achieved a personal best performance in the javelin event recording 161'-9" to finish sixth and Jock Whyte's 144'-4" hammer throw was good enough to place him 5th.
